evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters error handling in Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk() in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Prevents chainstate corruption and metadata desynchronization on disk I/O errors by halting FlushStateToDisk() if block or undo file flushes fail. Previously, FlushStateToDisk() ignored flush errors, advancing coins cache records and m_last_flushed_block despite non-durable block data.
